canonical_project: Nxtra by Airtel Hyderabad hyperscale data centre (up to 200MW)
notes: Airtel's Nxtra announced (Dec 2022) a hyperscale data centre in Hyderabad on ~40 acres with Rs 2,000 crore investment; first phase ~60MW IT load, campus planned up to 200MW. Nxtra CEO said the Hyderabad facility should be operational within ~2 years and at full capacity in ~5 years. Status reported by press as under development.
